descriptions.ua: We are the Unwavering Artisans, also known as UA. We are driven by a desire to create. We don't care if the art is good. We don't care if anyone likes it. We don't even care if we like it. What matters isn't what we make but that we choose to make it. To create is a divine act, it's good for the soul. And with the death of the artist, even that which you most despise could be the inspiration another artist needs, even if that inspiration comes in the form of "I bet I could do that better..."
descriptions.snide: We are S.N.I.D.E. We are the Society for Nihilistic Intent and Disruptive Efforts. We are the adversary to order. We are the pranksters. We are the fools. We wish to administer a wedgie to the world. We act through the sole desire to reflect the system in a funhouse mirror; to show that everything is a game, and nothing is worth any more than the value it is attributed by the person perceiving it. We have no goals (other than the wedgie thing, which S.N.I.D.E. scientists are working tirelessly in a secret undisclosed underground facility to develop a viable planetary wedgie administering system). We enjoy the game for the game and believe that it in itself is its most valuable reward.
